# ollama-agent (local) — distribution bundle

*Generated by `mtdr_packaging`. Do not edit; regenerate.*

This surface is **direct**: it reads canonical MTDR `SKILL.md` files unmodified. Nothing here
rewrites a skill, and nothing here adds record semantics — a packaging adapter that did either would be
a defect ([TDR-0024](../../../decisions/TDR-0024-packaging-independence.md)).

## Install

Install one record type's package with the repository's layout intact, and verify it where it sits
before executing from it ([`profiles/README.md`](../profiles/README.md)):

```
uv run python -m mtdr_packaging.profiles install <record-type> --runtime <runtime> --project <your project>
uv run python -m mtdr_packaging.profiles verify <installed package folder>
```

**Do not collect the skills flat into `./skills/`.** The record-package skills sit one or two levels deeper
than a flat directory, so collected flat their relative links leave the install — 66 of the catalogue's
107 skill links, in every Decision and Value lifecycle skill (22 Nov 2026). The flat collection in
[`canonical/skills/`](../canonical/skills/) is the catalogue's byte-identical copies, not an install.

**ollama-agent (local): not tested.** Whether it discovers a skill nested below its skills directory has not been shown, so `install` does not offer it; a flat collection would break the links above.

Discovery paths this runtime reads:

- `./skills/`
- `~/.ollama-agent/skills/`

- any directory passed to --skills-dir; last wins for same-name skills

## Invoke

CLI or REPL, model-selected from the skill description.

Progressive disclosure: Yes — descriptions are checked first; full instructions load only on a match.

## Reference knowledge

**Required, not optional, and it travels in the package.** The skills carry their canonical relative
links, written against the repository layout; rewriting them would modify a canonical artefact, which
packaging may never do. A folder package therefore keeps that layout — the skills, the substrate
specifications and schemas they use, and the record package's normative layer — so the links resolve
inside it. The links that point outside on purpose (decision records, practice notes, another record
type's specification) are listed under `not_packaged` in the package's `mtdr-package.json`, each with
its class; `verify` fails on any other. [`provenance.yaml`](../canonical/provenance.yaml) lists the
reference knowledge for the whole catalogue.

## The catalogue

30 skills, enumerated from the package manifests rather than a hand-maintained list:
[`catalogue.yaml`](../canonical/catalogue.yaml). Every surface ships the same catalogue; a surface
shipping a subset would be a different capability wearing the same name.

## What this bundle does not do

It does not make anything conformant, and using it establishes nothing about the execution that reads
it ([TDR-0032](../../../decisions/TDR-0032-typed-multi-object-conformance.md)). A conforming skill file
does not imply conforming behaviour.
